description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange, which models a generic schema interchange format used for configuration schema validation and documentation generation within the HTMLPurifier project. It includes properties for schema name and directives, and methods for adding directives and performing validation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange
classes.description: Represents a schema interchange format for configuration directives, capable of adding directives and validating the schema.

methods.name: addDirective
methods.description: Adds a directive to the directives array, throws an exception if a directive with the same id already exists.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the schema interchange using an external validator class.
